title: Prologue
overview: A sage with no magical talent begins his second reincarnation.

title: Lost Technology
overview: Eftal learns that magic in this new era is far weaker than he thought.

title: OVERKILL
overview: Eftal's father sets out on a plot to kill the crown prince, and Eftal gets involved.

title: Seek Freedom
overview: Eftal happens upon a slave and frees her from her wicked master.

title: Through Her Eyes
overview: Eftal is reunited with his old student.

title: Dear Eftal
overview: Eftal battles Merlin and shows off his strongest spell.

title: Master Smile
overview: Eftal becomes a student at a new magic academy.

title: No Escape
overview: Anastasia steals Raikiri and escapes to her real master.

title: Let Me Pay
overview: Anastasia turns to Eftal for help against her master.

title: Veiled Truth
overview: Anastasia and Merlin are afflicted by a curse that turns them into little children.

title: False Dawn
overview: Eftal battles the contract beast to free Anastasia.
